name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix + battle core-table domain + descriptor 'ai_best_spell_id' accurately reflects the AI's chosen (best-scoring) offensive-spell id. No Ghidra address residue. Matches the sibling result group (ai_best_spell_score/target_x/target_y).
purpose: Enemy AI offensive-spell planner scratchpad: stores the spell id of the best-scoring (spell, cast-tile) candidate chosen by fd2_ai_score_offensive_spell, later read by the AI executor/dispatcher to actually cast it.
logic_summary: Reset implicitly each pass (the planner only overwrites it together with best_score when a candidate wins). Writer fd2_ai_score_offensive_spell @0x15b12 stores spell_list[i] (a byte spell id zero-extended into the dword) when score beats the running best (tie-broken by spell base damage). Readers: fd2_attack_action_dispatch (@0x14fba/0x14fc8) branches on it in the phys==spell contest path; fd2_execute_ai_offensive_spell (@0x15321/0x153de/0x153f6/0x1540f) passes it to fd2_get_spell_effect_entry, gates the basic-cast path with a signed compare (id < 10), and indexes the spell handler table data_fd2_battle_spell_handler_table[id]. Compared signed against 0xb and 10. Value range = spell ids 0x00-0x23 (domain ID).
datatype: uint32 (BSS zero-init scalar; byte spell id zero-extended into the dword)
element_semantics: Single dword holding a spell id 0x00-0x23 (the chosen offensive spell). Stored as the byte spell id zero-extended; consumers compare it signed and use it as a spell-table index.
notes: BSS scalar, memory all-zero. is_const=false: live game-side writer fd2_ai_score_offensive_spell @0x15b12. src comment block (btl_aisc.c lines ~642-644) already precise and correct -> kept, src not modified. Ghidra had accurate documentation but in the wrong field (PRE_COMMENT) with the PLATE empty; per project data-plate convention (data plate must live in PLATE_COMMENT) migrated content into PLATE_COMMENT (ASCII, em-dash -> --) and cleared the now-redundant PRE_COMMENT -> ghidra_plate_action=created. Name rename not applied (Stage 2); verdict=keep so no rename pending anyway.
